# Real vendor samples

Publicly published TDX and SEV-SNP evidence and collateral, used by
`tests/vendor_samples.rs` to verify against the pinned vendor roots in
`roots/` (see `src/roots.rs`). The vendor endpoints (Intel PCS, AMD KDS) are
not reachable from the build sandbox, so every file comes from a published
open-source package, downloaded from the package registry (crates.io or the
Go module proxy) on 2026-11-13. Files are byte-for-byte copies unless noted.

Containers project), go-tdx-guest (Google LLC) and the Veraison projects;
MIT for dcap-qvl (Phala Network). The vendor-signed bytes inside the SNP
and TDX samples are AMD's and Intel's.

Still not bundled, because no published copy was reachable from the
sandbox (`kdsintf.amd.com` is blocked, and no package or repository
searched carries one): a real AMD KDS CRL. AMD revocation and the ARK CRL
floor are tested with generated chains (`tests/revocation.rs`). There is no
real Arm CCA silicon-vendor chain: the CCA samples are verified against
TF-A's reference platform key and Veraison reference keys.
